evals.name: preview-before-production-write
evals.prompt: 在 Octane 新建一个 High severity 的 IPA 加载失败缺陷。先给我完整草稿，不要创建。
evals.expected_output: Collects or asks for all required Octane reference IDs, calls validate_defect_ticket, and shows the resulting payload without calling commit_defect_ticket.

evals.name: native-approval-before-commit
evals.prompt: 草稿确认无误，现在创建这个 Octane defect。
evals.expected_output: Calls commit_defect_ticket only after the draft review. LibreChat displays its native approval controls and does not POST to Octane until the user approves.
